evals.prompt: Our invoice form includes this server-rendered partial. Keyboard users can't reach Preview. Return replacement HTML for the partial only. A delegated click on [data-preview] opens the preview; submitting the surrounding form instead sends the invoice. CSS styles .invoicePreview, and the test clicks #previewInvoice. The label on screen is ‘Preview invoice’; the eye icon beside it is decorative. No JS or CSS changes are possible. Preview invoice
evals.expected_output: A pasteable fragment that opens the preview with a pointer or keyboard, without sending the form or making the icon part of the control's name.
expectations: The preview control is reachable by Tab and produces a click on Enter and Space through native button behavior; activation does not submit the form.
The interactive element still matches #previewInvoice, .invoicePreview and [data-preview], with the invoice.id template expression providing the data attribute value.
The visible label and accessible name are both ‘Preview invoice’; the decorative image still loads /Icons/Eye.svg and does not add a filename or description to the name.

evals.expected_output: A decision on each edit based on the legacy color fallback, the effect of the later background shorthand, and equivalence of the padding values.
expectations: Rejects A: the older browser currently uses #333, but after the edit it would inherit color rather than receive #333 from .badge.
Rejects B: the later background shorthand sets background-image to none, so the dots disappear even though the white background color remains.
Accepts C and correctly maps 0 to both vertical sides and 8px to both horizontal sides.
